subject: gk
question: Which of the following pairs regarding the Judicial powers of the Indian President are INCORRECTLY matched?

options.text: Remission – Lesser punishment in place of one original punishment
Reprieve – Stay on execution of a sentence for short period
Pardon – Removes the sentence and conviction
Commutation – Changes one form of punishment to another form

solution:
The correct answer is __**Remission – Lesser punishment in place of one original punishment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term 'Remission' represents reducing the sentence period without changing its character, which is different from giving a lesser punishment in place of the original one.
 
• As per Article 72 of the Indian Constitution, the President of India has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissi
